purpose: Independently evaluate the unchanged v46 rank-only role-consensus cardinality rule on an untouched public dataset with explicit supporting table-cell annotations.

official_sources.dataset_license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 as stated by the official repository; verify the frozen LICENSE before opening the data member

allowed_metadata_seen: official repository name, task summary, data directory filenames and public branch commit id
official paper abstract and dataset-level count
official description of question, table, free-form answer and supporting table-cell pairs

source_access_order: Implement and test the FeTaQA schema adapter, candidate construction, sealed sampling, blind-cache boundary and evaluation using synthetic fixtures only while reusing the unchanged v46 selector.
Register implementation and test hashes before acquiring the frozen official source archive.
Acquire the archive without printing or browsing the registered dev JSONL member.
Verify revision, archive, LICENSE and registered member hashes before opening the dev JSONL.
Run a structural census and sealed candidate-ceiling check; stop before neural work if schema, minimum scope or exact supporting-cell alignment fails.
Generate all queries and neural scores without answer or highlighted-cell fields, then join supporting cells once for a locked evaluation.
Publish favorable, null, negative or inconclusive results and never tune on v47 cases.

dataset_scope.split: official data/fetaQA-v1_dev.jsonl at the frozen revision
eligible_row: stable feta id and nonempty question
rectangular or ragged nonempty table array with at least three nonempty cells
every highlighted coordinate maps exactly to a nonempty canonical cell candidate
dataset_scope.sampling_rule: Sort eligible ids by SHA-256 of 'FRC-FETAQA-V47|' plus id and then id; select the first 600 without replacement. If 400 to 599 are eligible, use all. If fewer than 400 are eligible, stop before query generation.

blind_candidate_construction.table_units: One candidate per nonempty table cell; canonical id cell_<row>_<column> preserves the official zero-based coordinate and candidate text includes page/section metadata plus row and column headers when available.
blind_candidate_construction.pool: Every nonempty cell from the attached table; no highlighted-cell pruning, answer matching or learned first-stage truncation.
stored_fields: question text only until query generation completes
forbidden_blind_fields: official split labels or retrieval scores
blind_candidate_construction.candidate_ceiling_registration: After sealed sampling and candidate construction, highlighted_cell_ids may be used only to verify exact coordinate coverage and registered strata counts. No method, formula, threshold, query or candidate member may change afterward.
blind_candidate_construction.protective_behavior: Any unmapped highlighted coordinate, duplicate id, forbidden blind field, alignment mismatch or nondeterministic rerun stops before query generation and writes no score cache.

frozen_models.score_calibration: per-case independent min-max inherited from v41

candidate_method_formula_unchanged_from_: Rank every candidate independently for each of the unchanged four v41 dynamic atomic roles, using canonical id as the only tie-breaker.
Let A be the distinct role-rank-1 candidate ids.
Give one runner-up vote per role to its rank-2 candidate only when that candidate is not in A.
Expand by one exactly when a non-argmax candidate receives at least two runner-up votes.
Set target_cardinality = min(5, max(1, abs(A) + consensus_expansion)).
Select with the unchanged v41 dynamic rank-coverage greedy objective under the frozen token budget, with no duplicates.
No score threshold, table position, answer, highlighted coordinate, gold count, dataset statistic or post-result rule may alter the target or selection.

query_generation.fallback: frozen label-neutral templates plus the original question

evaluation.gold_join: After complete ordered query and score caches validate, map highlighted_cell_ids to canonical cell ids.
evaluation.primary_metric: mean across budgets of supporting-cell macro F1
evaluation.macro_precision: Mean per-case fraction of selected cell ids in highlighted cell ids; empty prediction precision is 1.
evaluation.macro_recall: Mean per-case fraction of highlighted cell ids selected.
evaluation.macro_f1: Mean per-case harmonic mean of supporting-cell precision and recall.
mandatory_strata: one versus two versus three-or-more highlighted cells
table candidate-count quartiles determined before neural scoring
consensus expansion triggered versus not triggered
secondary_metrics: selected unit count and token cost
selection-set difference rates versus v43, v44 and v45

decision_rules.gate_2: Always remains NO-GO/SHADOW in v47; one public table-cell selection experiment cannot authorize CANARY or DEFAULT.
decision_rules.publication: Publish favorable, null, negative or inconclusive results with source, protocol, implementation, cache and result hashes.

known_scope_limits: FeTaQA supplies attached tables rather than open-corpus retrieval.
The endpoint is supporting-cell selection, not free-form answer generation.
The dataset tests structured table evidence only and does not cover text-table routing.
Wikipedia table evidence cannot replace district flood-domain expert evaluation.
